tierSelection.dailyDifficultyStrategy: use highest unlocked campaign tier, frozen when daily content first opened for the date
tierSelection.newWorldUnlock: new world tier becomes eligible the next day; do not swap today’s chosen challenge mid-day
tierSelection.repeatWarning: each tier currently has 10 distinct challenges and 10 bugs; stable-tier daily repetition every 10 days at latest
tierSelection.commandPolicy: Follow V14.1 Aventure cumulative primitive-only unlocks: 1 turn+forward, 2 backward, 3 pick, 4 use, 5 push, 6 activate, 7..10 no new command. SI and REPETE locked in daily modes.

bugMode.editRule: Player may change exactly one primitive command anywhere in the shown broken program; do not permit insertion/deletion; original altered index is hidden.
bugMode.validation: Accept any change of exactly one existing primitive line that wins. SI/REPETE never appear in the daily reference or broken programs.
bugMode.authoringProof: For every bug, the originally corrupted line has a unique winning replacement among commands unlocked for its tier; any other valid single-line fix is also accepted.

sourceDisclosure: Daily levels are old fixed V7 geometry variants; reference programs for tiers 7..10 have been flattened to proven primitive winning routes and bugs reauthored to match V14.1.
repeatWarning: Each tier has 10 challenges and 10 bugs, so daily selection repeats after ten dates if player stays in the same tier. This is a deliberate offline catalog limitation.
